svg.title: Locksmith — Man
svg.desc: A fictional man working as locksmith, wearing a work jacket. Visible work cue: A profiled lock cylinder with keyway is paired with a separate service key and a fine bent lock pick below. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Appearance: short curls, a softly squared face and round glasses.
